limitations: Three one-shot process attempts. Timeout/retry repetition, mixed-version concurrent binaries and PID reuse are abstracted; quarantine ownership and stale observations are explicit.
Private local filesystem, collision-free UUIDs, process liveness and atomic rename/exclusive create are assumptions. Hardware power loss and malicious same-UID mutation are outside the model.
Conformance exercises real controlled subprocess schedules and encrypted files, not exhaustive schedule equivalence.
Two original artifacts, two pending writes, one reset, one reset-process crash and one optional recovery-process crash. Artifact ciphertext is opaque; cryptographic correctness is assumed.

AccountProviderDeletion and AccountStorageMigration separately model bounded provider-wide deletion and per-file migration. Explicit account-list plans, remaining pool metadata operations and full host config rollback need separate models.

An interrupted reset has an unknown outcome. Recovery rolls credential deletion forward and never replays the host callback. Fsync and atomic rename supply durable ordering under the filesystem contract.
